description: Standards: the Mark needed to qualify in each Event, per Cycle, in sim units (frames for times, the original's pixels for distances and heights; ADR-0004). Cycles past the listed ones move by beyondStep per Cycle until they reach limit. remainingAttempts says what happens once a field Mark reaches the Standard: skip ends the Event there, play keeps the remaining Attempts. PROVISIONAL: none of these values has been measured from the original yet (#20). They are set from what the provisional Events allow, and will be replaced by the captured values.
